item.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
item.description: Problem: LLM inference cost and latency could be inflated by an attacker. Approach: per the title, Rowhammer bit-flips are used to amplify inference latency and cost. Result: not verified. Why it matters: it would make hardware faults a resource-exhaustion vector against hosted models. Jargon: Rowhammer (repeated DRAM row access that flips neighbouring bits).
